name: Scavenger Paw
summary: In Deathknell, Scavenger Paw comes from young, ragged wolves on the hills. Newly awakened Forsaken gather the paws so local caretakers can stitch them into crude protective gear.

sections.title: Cobbled Armor in Deathknell
sections.body:
Newly returned Forsaken in Deathknell have little to spare. The Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade press against Tirisfal, so every scrap of hide and bone finds practical use. Novice Elreth assists Shadow Priest Sarvis by gathering paws from scavenger wolves, along with bat wings.

She makes serviceable garments and armor for Forsaken newly risen from their graves. They are still disoriented by their return.

faq.q: What are Scavenger Paws used for?
faq.answer: Novice Elreth gathers Scavenger Paws in Deathknell and stitches animal parts into basic garments and armor for newly risen Forsaken.
You find them on Young Scavengers and Ragged Scavengers, feral wolves roaming the woods and fields around Deathknell.
Novice Elreth asks for the paws. She assists Shadow Priest Sarvis by treating wounded recruits, tailoring equipment, and outfitting those sent into the field.

angles.text: As a newly awakened Forsaken with decaying flesh and little gear, you can gather parts from local predators to make enough armor for Tirisfal's dangers.
As a tailor, you can see how Novice Elreth stitches wolf paws and bat wings into crude gear for the young Forsaken settlements.
